messages:
Eli (Product): Morning folks, starting today! Two quick setup asks: 1) How do I get on the Figma org and the shared 'Product UI Kit'? 2) Where do we keep the roadmap and research briefs? Also curious about the regular critique / design review rhythm. cc @Marta

Marta (Design): Welcome Eli 44b Figma is SSO via Okta. Path: Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'. If it sits pending ping @Sam. I'll add you to the Product UI Kit after your account is active.

Sam (Design Ops): Hey Eli 496 Auto-approvals run during business hours but sometimes manual is needed. If pending DM me and I'll force-invite. Research briefs live in Drive -> design/research/playbooks and we tag active studies in #design-research. Roadmap lives in Confluence under /product/roadmap.

Eli (Product): Nice. And critique cadence? do we have a weekly slot or ad-hoc?

Marta (Design): We run two things: weekly "Design Crit" every Tuesday 10:30am PT (open to all) for early sketches, and a monthly "Product Review" where PMs present roadmap progress. For design reviews of production work we use Figma comments + a short async note in the playbook.

Rory (PM): Adding: if you want a walkthrough of the roadmap and current priorities I can do 20 mins at 4pm PT. Also our research stack: we use UserTesting + internal panel for recruits; Sam manages the vendor queue.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Eli. Ticket #ACC-9340. Est. processing 1-2 hours.

Eli (Product): I requested via Okta and it shows pending. Sam I'll DM the ticket. 4pm works for the roadmap walk. Thanks!

Sam (Design Ops): Manual invite done; you should have an email invite from Figma and access to the Product UI Kit. I've also added you to the Design Crit calendar and dropped a "first-week checklist" doc in the playbooks folder (includes brief template, recruiting steps, and critique etiquette).

Eli (Product): Got the invite and calendar adds. Appreciate it 60a I'll skim the checklist and see you at 4pm for the roadmap.
